import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint, QRect, QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QIcon, QIconEngine, QPainter, QPixmap, QRegion, QStandardItem, QStandardItemModel
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QFrame, QHBoxLayout, QListView, QVBoxLayout, QWidget
python.setup:
class GlyphEngine(QIconEngine):
    def __init__(self, glyph):
        super().__init__()
        self._glyph = glyph
    def clone(self):
        return GlyphEngine(self._glyph)
    def pixmap(self, size, mode, state):
        pm = QPixmap(size)
        pm.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        renderer = fluentqt.FontIcon(self._glyph)
        renderer.setIconSize(min(size.width(), size.height()))
        renderer.setEnabled(mode != QIcon.Mode.Disabled)
        renderer.resize(size)
        painter = QPainter(pm)
        renderer.render(painter, QPoint(), QRegion(), QWidget.RenderFlag.DrawChildren)
        painter.end()
        return pm
    def paint(self, painter, rect, mode, state):
        dpr = max(1, round(painter.device().devicePixelRatioF())) if painter.device() else 1
        painter.drawPixmap(rect, self.pixmap(rect.size() * dpr, mode, state))

root_layout = QVBoxLayout(%PARENT%)
root_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
control = fluentqt.NavigationView(%PARENT%)
root_layout.addWidget(control)
control.setDisplayMode(fluentqt.NavigationView.DisplayMode.Left)
control.setExpandedPaneWidth(168)
header = QWidget(control)
header_layout = QHBoxLayout(header)
header_layout.setContentsMargins(4, 4, 4, 4)
header_layout.setSpacing(6)
toggle = fluentqt.Button(header)
toggle.setIconGlyph(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.GlobalNav)
toggle.setFluentLayout(fluentqt.Button.ButtonLayout.IconOnly)
toggle.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Subtle)
toggle.setAccessibleName("Toggle navigation pane")
toggle.setFixedSize(36, 32)
brand = fluentqt.Label("Workspace", header)
brand.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
header_layout.addWidget(toggle)
header_layout.addWidget(brand, 1)
control.setHeaderChromeWidget(header)
toggle.clicked.connect(lambda: control.setPaneOpen(not control.isPaneOpen()))
nav_list = fluentqt.ListView(control)
nav_list.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
nav_list.setBackgroundVisible(False)
nav_list.setBorderVisible(False)
nav_list.setIconSize(QSize(16, 16))
nav_model = QStandardItemModel(nav_list)
entries = [
    ("Home", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Home, "Pinned projects & status", "Jump back to active Fluent component kits and recent workspace changes."),
    ("Explore", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Search, "Design kits & templates", "Browse adaptive layouts, typography tokens, and starter pages."),
    ("Settings", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Settings, "Appearance & behavior", "Adjust Light/Dark tokens, pane density, and navigation chrome modes."),
]
for title, glyph, _summary, _detail in entries:
    item = QStandardItem(QIcon(GlyphEngine(glyph)), title)
    item.setToolTip(title)
    nav_model.appendRow(item)
nav_list.setModel(nav_model)
control.setMainChromeWidget(nav_list)
minimal_toggles = []
for row, (title, _glyph, summary, detail) in enumerate(entries):
    page = QWidget(control.contentHost())
    page_layout = QVBoxLayout(page)
    page_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 14, 16, 14)
    page_layout.setSpacing(10)
    top_row = QHBoxLayout()
    top_row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
    top_row.setSpacing(8)
    min_toggle = fluentqt.Button(page)
    min_toggle.setIconGlyph(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.GlobalNav)
    min_toggle.setFluentLayout(fluentqt.Button.ButtonLayout.IconOnly)
    min_toggle.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Subtle)
    min_toggle.setAccessibleName("Open navigation menu")
    min_toggle.setFixedSize(32, 28)
    min_toggle.clicked.connect(lambda: control.setPaneOpen(True))
    minimal_toggles.append(min_toggle)
    title_label = fluentqt.Label(title, page)
    title_label.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
    top_row.addWidget(min_toggle)
    top_row.addWidget(title_label, 1)
    page_layout.addLayout(top_row)
    card = fluentqt.Card(page)
    card_layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
    card_layout.setContentsMargins(14, 12, 14, 12)
    card_layout.setSpacing(4)
    card_title = fluentqt.Label(summary, card)
    card_title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
    card_body = fluentqt.Label(detail, card)
    card_body.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
    card_body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
    card_body.setWordWrap(True)
    card_layout.addWidget(card_title)
    card_layout.addWidget(card_body)
    page_layout.addWidget(card)
    page_layout.addStretch(1)
    control.contentHost().insertPage(row, page)

def sync_chrome(*_args):
    mode = control.effectiveDisplayMode()
    open_state = control.isPaneOpen()
    modes = fluentqt.NavigationView.DisplayMode
    top = mode == modes.Top
    compact_closed = mode in (modes.Left, modes.LeftCompact) and not open_state
    minimal_closed = mode == modes.LeftMinimal and not open_state
    compact_margin = max(2, (control.compactPaneWidth() - toggle.minimumWidth()) // 2)
    header_layout.setContentsMargins(12 if top else (compact_margin if compact_closed else 4), 4, 4, 4)
    toggle.setVisible(not top)
    brand.setVisible(not compact_closed)
    nav_list.setFlow(QListView.Flow.LeftToRight if top else QListView.Flow.TopToBottom)
    nav_list.setWrapping(False)
    nav_list.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
    nav_list.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff if top else Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAsNeeded)
    if top:
        nav_list.setFixedHeight(control.topBarHeight())
        nav_list.setFixedWidth(368)
    else:
        nav_list.setMinimumSize(0, 0)
        nav_list.setMaximumSize(16777215, 16777215)
    top_item_height = max(34, min(44, control.topBarHeight() - 6))
    for i in range(nav_model.rowCount()):
        item = nav_model.item(i)
        if item is not None:
            item.setSizeHint(QSize(88, top_item_height) if top else QSize())
    for btn in minimal_toggles:
        btn.setVisible(minimal_closed)

control.displayModeChanged.connect(sync_chrome)
control.effectiveDisplayModeChanged.connect(sync_chrome)
control.paneOpenChanged.connect(sync_chrome)
control.compactPaneWidthChanged.connect(sync_chrome)
control.topBarHeightChanged.connect(sync_chrome)
nav_list.selectionModel().currentChanged.connect(lambda index, previous: control.contentHost().setCurrentIndex(index.row(), 0, False))
sync_chrome()
nav_list.setCurrentIndex(nav_model.index(0, 0))
